flags.message: All three predictions were created on the resolution date (2026-11-19, about 14:35-14:57Z), and outcome.json's resolved_at carries a date only. I graded leakage as not applicable on the strength of the withdrawal letter's docket filename stamp (2026-11-19 15:55) being later than the predictions, plus the two candidates that checked the live docket reporting it as still pending. A resolution timestamp in the outcome would make this same-day ordering checkable directly.
